name: @pipeworx/mcp-opentopodata

tools.name: elevation
tools.description: Elevation at points. Up to 100 locations per request.

locations.description: Array of {lat, lon} (up to 100). Single object also accepted.

samples.description: Optional: interpolate N samples between first and last point.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-opentopodata forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the opentopodata pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
